extracted.name: Cucumber Bites with Dill Cream and Smoked Salmon
extracted.description: These elegant smoked salmon appetizer bites are easy to make for your next party with cream cheese, cucumber slices, smoked salmon, dill, and lemon.
ingredient_lines: 4 ounces smoked salmon, cut into 2-inch strips
instruction_lines: Form a cup in each cucumber slice by using a melon baller to scoop a 1/2-inch-deep depression from one side. Place cucumbers, scooped-sides down, onto paper towels to drain for 15 minutes.
Mix cream cheese, chopped dill, lemon zest, lemon juice, and pepper in a bowl until well combined.
Spoon about 1/2 teaspoon cheese mixture into each cucumber cup. Top each cup with a salmon strip and a dill sprig.
